label: Explored the leap into absurdity without Kierkegaard's religious leap of faith
description: Albert Camus adopted Søren Kierkegaard's insights and systematically extended them into new metaphysical, ethical, or epistemological domains.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from Søren Kierkegaard's perspective to Albert Camus's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Inter-epochal reception: transmitting insights from the 19th Century Divergences across history into the 20th Century Phenomenon & Analysis.

label: Formulated and introduced The Leap of Faith & Existential Dread
description: Søren Kierkegaard formulated and introduced the concept of "The Leap of Faith & Existential Dread", which became a seminal contribution in ethics philosophy.
dialecticalTension: Formulating an epistemic apparatus to resolve central problems in ethics.
historicalContext: Introduced during the 19th Century Divergences as part of Søren Kierkegaard's canonical writings.
